description_en: Queries the feature configurations of a domain name
description_zh: 调用本接口查询域名配置，一次可查询多个功能配置
name: DescribeVodDomainConfigs

parameters.description_en: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD. You can query only one domain name.
parameters.description_zh: 点播加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名。
parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name for ApsaraVideo VOD. You can query only one domain name
parameters.help_zh: 点播加速域名，仅支持查询单个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.description_en: The name of the feature. You can query the configurations of multiple features at a time. Separate multiple feature names with commas (,). For features that can be configured for accelerated domain names for ApsaraVideo VOD and the names of the features, see [Functions for domain name configurations](~~2411639~~).
parameters.description_zh: 功能名称。一次可查询多个功能配置信息，多个功能名称之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。点播加速域名支持配置的功能及各功能名称，请参见[域名配置功能函数](~~2411639~~)。
